snippet.title: Imperiums: Rome vs Carthage release trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839160/Imperiums_Rome_vs_Carthage/
Historical 4X turn-based strategy game set in time of Roman expansion.

Preorder here https://imperiumsgame.com/purchase/ or wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839160/Imperiums_Rome_vs_Carthage/ and get a launch discount!

Imperiums: Rome vs Carthage will test your tactical and strategic genius to the limits. Can the established empires defend the current world order, or will they be forced to make room for new rising states? Go through the fires of war, be destroyed or rise from the ashes to become the new hegemon!

Forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1183470/discussions/
Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/hq9NC5Q
